## Summary

Five+ years shipping SaaS platforms that outlive the sprint that made them.
Frontend architecture, multi-tenant systems, SSR at scale, design systems,
technical leadership and mentoring.

## Work history

- SoftMind (2026–present) — Senior Software Engineer, Lebanon. Regional SaaS
  ERP provider (est. 1996) serving 1,500+ companies across 8 countries:
  SoftOffice ERP, SM RetaileR POS, SM HR and SM BrokerS insurance brokerage.
  Finance, inventory, production, payroll and claims workflows.
- Sowlutions Inc (2024–2026) — Senior Software Engineer, Lebanon. Led a
  frontend team of 3; owned Haqq.ai, a multi-tenant legal platform with 6
  business modules serving 50+ companies and 120,000 users. Vue, Nuxt 3 SSR,
  TypeScript, Docker, CI/CD.
- Skeldus (2023–2024) — Frontend Engineer, Remote/New York. Cybersecurity and
  compliance SaaS dashboards (13+ interfaces). React, Next.js. +25% reliability.
- Numbase Group (2022–2023) — Frontend Engineer, Remote/Qatar. Real-time chat
  and notifications with Socket.io; architecture rewrite, −40% latency.
- Docclik (2021–2022) — Full-Stack Web Developer, Remote/Canada. Healthcare
  scheduling for thousands of practitioners; −40% load time, +30% scheduling
  efficiency.
- Codi Tech (2021) — Boot Camp Full-Stack Developer. ERP and medical
  management system on the MERN stack.

## Stack

Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue.js, Nuxt.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3,
Tailwind CSS, Ant Design. Backend: Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, SQL,
PostgreSQL, MongoDB. DevOps: Docker, CI/CD, Nginx, Caddy, VPS deployment.
Architecture: design patterns, SSR, responsive design, code reviews, Agile.
AI: AI-assisted architecture analysis, AI dev workflows, custom agents.

## About this page

The hero is an interactive WebGL particle field: one particle per user served
(~1M). Crawlers and readers without JavaScript get the same words as static
HTML in the document body plus the JSON-LD `Person` block.
